<?php
/**
 * {{PLUGIN_NAME}} Dashboard Widget
 * Generated by WPFetcher.
 */

add_action('wp_dashboard_setup', '{{CUSTOM_PREFIX}}_add_dashboard_widget');

function {{CUSTOM_PREFIX}}_add_dashboard_widget() {
    wp_add_dashboard_widget(
        '{{slug}}_widget',
        '{{PLUGIN_NAME}} Status',
        '{{CUSTOM_PREFIX}}_widget_render'
    );
}

function {{CUSTOM_PREFIX}}_widget_render() {
    echo '<p>Welcome to your custom widget for {{PLUGIN_NAME}}.</p>';
}
